run_LTXImageToVideoPipeline: run the LTXImageToVideoPipeline to generate a video from an input image and text prompt
run_encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into T5 hidden state embeddings with optional negative prompt and classifier-free guidance
run_prepare_latents: prepare image-conditioned latents with a conditioning mask for the first frame in the diffusion pipeline
run__pack_latents: pack 5D latent tensors into 3D packed tokens for transformer processing
run__unpack_latents: unpack 3D packed latent tokens back into 5D video latent tensors
